review_evidence: Reviewed the complete 367-file primary inventory: 214 .pvs theories and 153 .prf proof files, distributed across Examples (180), lib (134), doc (45), src (6) and eclipse (2).

Representative and path-wide inspection shows these are object-level PVS theories/proofs, including algebra/data structures, finite sets, bitvectors, temporal/hardware examples, tutorial theories and prover library material; path names such as Examples/doc do not make checked formal content disposable.
No lossless maintenance-only selector was established for this unit, so the conservative default-retain disposition preserves all formal PVS prior art.
summary: Reviewed the PVS source distribution; retain all 214 PVS theory files and 153 proof files across libraries, examples, documentation examples and system sources.
